MORE

Prayer & Settings

Keep the app simple and shape it around your prayer rule.

The app is a tool for prayer. It does not replace the guidance of your father of confession.
PRAYER RULE

With My Father of Confession

This is an optional way to record that your prayer rule was set together with your father of confession. Nothing here gives anyone access to your prayer activity.

Private by default

Your prayer rule and prayer activity stay on this device. This version does not send activity to a priest or create a priest dashboard.

CONFESSION

Schedule & Reminder

Keep a private record of your last confession and, if you wish, schedule the next one. The Coptic Orthodox Diocese of the Southern United States teaches that one should confess at least every forty days, while emphasizing that the instruction of one's spiritual father is important.

The Southern Diocese Q&A says, “One should confess AT LEAST every forty days,” and immediately adds that the instruction of the spiritual father is important too.

Read the Diocese Q&A
Private

This information stays on this device in this version and is not shared with your priest.

SOURCES & TRUST

Church Sources

The app is designed to present the prayers and teaching of the Church without adding AI-written spiritual interpretation.

Agpeya prayers

Prayer text is taken from the Agpeya source supplied for this app: The Agpeya (The Book of Hours), translated from the Coptic language, Saint Mary’s Coptic Orthodox Church, Kitchener, Ontario.

Daily Coptic readings & calendar

Daily lectionary, Coptic date, liturgical season, feast and fasting data are retrieved from Coptic.io.

View source documentation
Synaxarium

Daily Synaxarium material is retrieved through the Coptic.io source. The app does not create or rewrite saint lives as spiritual commentary.

Open CopticChurch.net Synaxarium
Confession guidance

The 40-day confession guidance is sourced to the Coptic Orthodox Diocese of the Southern United States. The Diocese also emphasizes the importance of the instruction of one’s spiritual father.

Read the Diocese Q&A
Church Fathers

Patristic quotations are limited to verified direct quotations from the Oriental Orthodox tradition, with the Father and source work identified. The app does not generate a meditation beneath the quotation.

The Church provides the prayers and teaching. Your father of confession helps guide your prayer rule. The app helps you live it throughout the day.
